answer: The fee is charged through a reef debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the sable totals, and the mesa anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 7 units per epoch, sustaining 168 aliases for 42 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. Each copy needs 15 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
